author: /root/compiler_research
scope: Source review of full 372-line runner, control tests, frozen dependencies and inherited aggregation; independent execution of eight synthetic runner controls. Actual CP01 arithmetic independently recomputed by the separate recorded review.
checks: prepare requires clean committed source and freezes binaries, LLVM/linker identities, helper/oracle bytes, corpus, environment, CPU quota, affinity, and paired order before measurement
build/check and each cold/unchanged/private/public request are distinct; all start a new CLI session
timed scope contains the full CLI; native behavior checks and source hashing occur outside it
each reported success requires verification_runs=1 and unchanged source bytes; failures and timeouts stay in records
formal measurement requires matching complete passing preflight; incomplete or invalid numerical records suppress aggregate score
paired-block means precede across-block medians and weighted absolute costs; whole paired blocks are resampled
cleanup only removes the fresh sequence work directory after all four requests; retained raw logs, frozen fixtures and hashes lie outside it
three/five-block bootstrap is labelled exploratory; process-tree CPU and max-process RSS boundaries are explicit
limits: Source binding is an explicit caller declaration backed by separate build receipts; the runner does not reverse-engineer a binary's source commit.
A quiet-window flag is an operator assertion; a shared host is not physically exclusive.
Successful finite source consumers are not whole-language or product acceptance.
Summary relies on preserved execution records; independent forensic review additionally verifies raw output hashes.
